basics.name: Kilian Pouderoux
basics.label: MSc Microengineering Student
basics.summary: Final-year Master’s student in Microengineering at EPFL and CentraleSupélec, completing my Master’s thesis at Coherent. With expertise in microsystems, optics, and nanotechnology, I bring strong curiosity, organization, and autonomy to my work. I graduate in February 2027 and am seeking a full-time position in high-tech, fast-moving projects, starting in June 2027.

interestsIntro: My technical expertise lies at the intersection of microsystems, optics and intelligent software. From developing ground station architecture for CubeSat missions to designing microfluidic platforms at IMEC and characterizing high-power lasers at Coherent, I thrive on bridging the gap between embedded hardware and high performance computing. I am particularly driven by the challenge of building high-impact systems in multidisciplinary environments.

Outside of engineering, I’m deeply curious about the broader scientific landscape, especially astronomy and the mechanics of space exploration. Sport addict, I spend most of my free time on the water, improving my kitesurfing and pumpfoiling skills.

education.area: Microengineering, minor in Computational Science and Engineering
Engineering, highly selective double degree with EPFL

work.summary: Master's thesis on the experimental investigation of grating properties in high-power DFB lasers, combining optical setup development, device characterization, and simulation to establish robust laser design rules.
highlights: Design and build an automated free-space and fiber-based optical setup for the electro-optical characterization of laser devices
Develop data analysis pipelines to process, visualize, and validate key laser performance metrics
Simulate DFB laser behavior and compare it with measurements to assess grating and epitaxial design variations

work.summary: Interdisciplinary research internship combining microfluidics, photonics, and systems engineering to develop an integrated on-chip cell sorting platform for biomedical diagnostics applications.
highlights: Designed and assembled an integrated optical and microfluidic setup, combining fluidic, electronic, and photonic components
Developed data acquisition and processing pipelines to analyze and visualize cell sorting performance metrics
Prepared biological samples and conducted wet lab experiments to characterize the chip's sorting performance

work.summary: Diagnosing, maintaining, and optimizing a LabVIEW-based machine in a high-precision manufacturing environment.
Discovered the operating environment of a vacuum-technology company by preparing orders for the shipping and production departments and handling inventory and delivery errors.

work.company: École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne, EPFL
work.summary: Teaching assistant for several undergraduate courses including Materials Science, Programming,  Mathematics, and Information, Computation and Communication.

volunteer.summary: Student association focused on the design, development, and launch of innovative satellite and space related projects.
highlights: Led a team of 8 to develop and operate ground stations for satellite communications.
Developed and assembled an X-band antenna, the first student-operated system of its kind.
Developed full-stack software for distributed antenna control and mission control.
Contributed to a digital twin for satellite modeling, enabling faster design iterations and performance optimization.
Performed tradeoff analyses on critical satellite parameters, guiding key design decisions and improving mission reliability.

Organized surf, pumpfoil, winch surf, and wakesurf sessions for EPFL & UNIL students. Managed partnerships and sponsorship acquisition to support the association's activities.

Managed partner-company relations and event logistics for a major business forum with 200+ exhibitors and a €1.3M turnover, while handling quality management through the annual audit and ISO compliance. Developed automation algorithms to streamline repetitive tasks and improve team efficiency.
